api/src/__init__.py.name: Server package
api/src/__init__.py.description: Marks the main server folder as one importable package so its parts can load each other.

api/src/config.py.name: Server settings
api/src/config.py.description: Reads the server's settings from its environment and checks them before anything starts.

api/src/dev/__init__.py.name: Development helpers
api/src/dev/__init__.py.description: Holds tools used only on development machines, never when the product is running.

api/src/dev/scheduler_fixtures.py.name: Scheduled-work sample data
api/src/dev/scheduler_fixtures.py.description: Fills a test install with predictable scheduled work, runs it, and checks every piece happened as expected.

api/src/main.py.name: Server startup
api/src/main.py.description: Starts the main server: connects the database and saved copies, loads every area of requests, and creates the first admin account.

api/src/sdk/__init__.py.name: Workflow toolkit
api/src/sdk/__init__.py.description: The markers workflow authors use to label their work, data lookups and AI tools.

api/src/sdk/context.py.name: Workflow context
api/src/sdk/context.py.description: Hands the current run's context to workflow code from one shared place.

api/src/sdk/decorators.py.name: Workflow markers
api/src/sdk/decorators.py.description: Marks which functions are workflows, agent tools, data lookups or always-on services.

api/src/sdk/error_handling.py.name: Workflow errors
api/src/sdk/error_handling.py.description: The standard error types a workflow can raise so a failure reaches people with a reason they can act on.

api/src/sdk/errors.py.name: Error types
api/src/sdk/errors.py.description: Defines the errors workflow code can raise, including ones whose message is shown to the person running it.

GET /.name: Server availability
GET /.description: Confirms the main server is up and answering before anything else is asked of it.
